summary: Iteration 29 — Gym-owners niche tiers + Who-We-Serve mega menu + GymCheckoutDialog + ExitIntentModal + homepage promo strip. ALL backend + frontend acceptance items PASS. 54/54 pytest cases green (including the 3 prior-iteration files plus 9 new test_iteration_29 tests). Frontend Playwright verified: Who-We-Serve section + 2 cards, mega menu with 4 gym-owners links, /gym-owners → /how-it-works → /process → /results all 200 + render their h1, 3 pricing tier PayPal buttons render, GymCheckoutDialog opens with prefill hint visible when empty + hides after valid fill, PayPal Smart Buttons iframes render after fill, payment plan toggle updates 'You pay $X today' (4,497.50 split → 8,495 full upfront, $500 discount applied), ROI calc input updates Monthly loss to $1,200 for 10 lost members @ $120, detailed ROI on /results has 3 inputs + 6 stat tiles and the churn slider updates the math, and the ExitIntentModal mounts and fires (radix dialog data-state=open) on mouseleave-top after 6s. critical_code_review_comments: paypal_routes.PACKAGE_TIERS correctly carries niche='gym_owners' + inclusions[]>=3 + timeline + support_tier mapping on all 3 gym tiers. NICHE_TIER_ALIASES collapses gym_* into their generic equivalents for legacy accounting paths.

create_order writes niche=cfg.get('niche') at the top level + nests {niche, inclusions, timeline} into metadata only when the tier has a niche — so generic 'custom' orders are unaffected (regression preserved).
support_subscription_routes.PACKAGE_TO_SUPPORT_TIER maps gym_express→standard, gym_custom→premium, gym_enterprise→vip — matches PRD.
Frontend WhoWeServe.jsx — both cards have data-testid, gym card navigates correctly, Coming Soon card is visually disabled but still discoverable.
Header.jsx mega-trigger-who-we-serve renders the panel on hover with 5 items (industries + 3 playbook links + featured CTA). All 4 expected /gym-owners* links present.

GymCheckoutDialog.jsx — proper progressive disclosure: prefill hint shown until name AND valid email present, then PayPal Smart Buttons iframe mounts. Plan toggle updates the 'You pay $X today' label correctly with the $500 discount on full_upfront.
ExitIntentModal mounts via GymLayout and only fires on mouseleave-top after the 6s arm window — non-annoying.

Minor: roi-calc-detailed insight tile elements don't carry a 'tile' or 'card' className/testid; they're visible as 6 stat blocks in the screenshot but harder to assert against in automation. Consider adding [data-testid=roi-detailed-tile-{name}] on each of the 6 stat cards for future regression coverage.

Minor nit (still present from earlier iteration): no /api/admin/login route — admin uses /api/auth/login. Not a bug, just worth noting that the request-prompt mentioned /api/admin/login and the actual endpoint is /api/auth/login.
